title: Group Anagrams
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of words.
Next n lines: one lowercase word per line.
outputFormat: One group per line. Within a group the words are sorted lexicographically and separated by single spaces; groups are printed in ascending order of their first word.
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^4
1 <= |word| <= 100
Every word consists of lowercase English letters.

examples.input:
6
eat
tea
tan
ate
nat
bat
examples.output:
ate eat tea
bat
nat tan
examples.explanation: Three anagram groups, each sorted internally and ordered by first word.
A single word forms a single group.
